title: PPProbeCommandlet calls ParseCommandLine with 2 args; UE 5.8 has no such overload, and switch tokens never land in Tokens
detail: No 2-arg overload exists, so the engine build fails. Even with 3 args, '-seed=' tokens go to Switches with the dash stripped, so the Tokens loop never matches and all params are silently ignored (defaults coincide with CI, hiding it; -json is lost).
recommended_fix: Call the 3-arg overload with a Switches array and iterate Switches (or use the 4-arg Params overload / FParse::Value); add an assertion that -json was parsed when expected.

title: PPProbeCommandlet.cpp uses LogPPCore without including the header that declares it
detail: LogPPCore's extern declaration is only in PacketPlumberCore.h, which this translation unit never includes (PP_Rng.h/PP_Sim.h are UE-header-free and don't pull it in) — undeclared identifier, compile error.
recommended_fix: Add #include "PacketPlumberCore/PacketPlumberCore.h" to PPProbeCommandlet.cpp (and drop the unused PlatformFileManager.h/OutputDeviceNull.h includes).

title: Spine headers are invisible to the test/editor modules: flat module layout exports no include paths under BuildSettingsVersion.V5
evidence: Source/PacketPlumberCore/ contains only PP_Hash.h, PP_Rng.h, PP_Sim.h, PP_SimState.h, PacketPlumberCore.{h,cpp,Build.cs} — no Public/ dir. Consumers include e.g. Source/PacketPlumberCoreTests/PP_DeterminismTests.cpp:6:#include "PacketPlumberCore/PP_Sim.h". Installed UBT 5.8 UEBuildModuleCPP.cs:442: if (ModuleDir.TryGetDirectory("Public", out ...) && PublicDirectory.ContainsFiles(...)) { PublicIncludePaths.Add(PublicDirectory.Location); } (module root only goes to LegacyPublicIncludePaths); UEBuildModule.cs:721-733: AddIncludePaths(IncludePaths, PublicIncludePaths); legacy paths only if bLegacyPublicIncludePaths/bLegacyParentIncludePaths. ModuleRules.cs:1476: get => bLegacyPublicIncludePathsPrivate ?? ((DefaultBuildSettings < BuildSettingsVersion.V2) && ...); — repo targets pin DefaultBuildSettings = BuildSettingsVersion.V5.
detail: PacketPlumberCore has no Public/ folder, so its exported include-path set is empty under V5; PacketPlumberCoreTests and PacketPlumberEditor cannot resolve any PacketPlumberCore include — the entire engine build (gates 4-7) fails.
recommended_fix: Move spine headers to Source/PacketPlumberCore/Public/PacketPlumberCore/PP_*.h (matching the 'PacketPlumberCore/PP_Sim.h' include style already used) — standalone build stays fine since tests compile with -I Source/PacketPlumberCore/Public/PacketPlumberCore's parent adjustments.

title: Golden gate never compares the engine PPProbe: docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json has no producer
evidence:
scripts/local-ci.sh:75: "ENGINE:PPProbe commandlet (headless spine probe)|scripts/run-tests-headless.sh --probe" — no --json-out. scripts/compare-golden.sh:26-32:
if [ -f docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json ]; then
  A="docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json"
  ...
else
  A="$GOLDEN" ... WHAT="committed golden vs standalone spine-check"
grep -rn 'engine-probe' across scripts/ docs/ README.md AGENTS.md matches only compare-golden.sh itself; gate 8 is labeled "ENGINE:Golden compare (PPProbe vs docs/goldens/)" (local-ci.sh:76).
detail: Nothing ever writes .engine-probe.json, so gate 8 always compares the committed golden against the standalone runner that produced it — engine numbers are never checked despite the gate label. The cross-runner ODN-9 contract is never asserted, violating the repo's own no-false-green rule.
recommended_fix: Change gate 7 to 'scripts/run-tests-headless.sh --probe --json-out docs/goldens/.engine-probe.json' so compare-golden.sh takes the engine-vs-standalone branch.

title: 8 Source files fail the repo's own format gate; scripts/local-ci.sh --fast fails at gate 1 once clang-format is reachable
evidence:
Running ./scripts/format-check.sh at this sha prints:
NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberCore/PP_Hash.h
NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberCore/PP_Rng.h
NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberCore/PP_Sim.h
NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberCoreTests/PP_DeterminismTests.cpp
NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberCoreTests/PP_HashTests.cpp
NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberCoreTests/PP_RngTests.cpp
NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberEditor/PPProbeCommandlet.cpp
NOT FORMATTED: Source/PacketPlumberEditor/PPProbeCommandlet.h
(exit 1). Sample diff for PP_Hash.h: file has 'inline uint64_t Fnv1a64(const uint8_t *Data, size_t Size)' and aligned 'FNV64_PRIME  = 0x100000001b3ull;      //' — clang-format wants 'const uint8_t* Data'. PP_Sim.h has 'if (OutCapacity < Needed) { return 0; }' one-liners clang-format expands. Running ./scripts/local-ci.sh --fast now yields 'gate 1 failed — stopping' (UE 5.8 is now installed on this machine, so the ENGINE:-labeled gate runs).
detail: The committed code does not conform to the repo's own .clang-format; every full CI run from now on fails at gate 1 before reaching spine/static/build gates.
recommended_fix: Run clang-format -i over the eight listed files (config already committed), then re-run scripts/format-check.sh.

title: Format gate is labeled ENGINE: so it skips engine-free, contradicting README/AGENTS/PR claims and dead-coding the system-clang-format fallback
evidence: scripts/local-ci.sh:70: "ENGINE:Format (clang-format --dry-run on Source/)|scripts/format-check.sh". But format-check.sh is engine-free by design: 'Prefers the engine-bundled clang-format (UE 5.8 ships one); falls back to a system clang-format >= 14.' README.md:21: '| CI | `scripts/local-ci.sh` — format / spine / static gates run without the engine'. AGENTS.md:17: '- `scripts/local-ci.sh --fast` — format, spine, static gates.' docs/timings.md rows: 'gate 1	ENGINE:Format (clang-format --dry-run on Source/)	SKIP	0s' (both recorded runs). A system clang-format exists at /opt/homebrew/opt/llvm/bin/clang-format.
detail: Docs and PR body claim the format gate runs engine-free, but the ENGINE: label skips it whenever the engine binary is absent — so Source/ formatting was never verified at this sha (see the 8 dirty files).
recommended_fix: Drop the ENGINE: prefix from the gate-1 label so format-check.sh runs engine-free with its system fallback; keep the engine-bundled binary as the preferred formatter.

title: "34 checks" claim is hardcoded and wrong — the spine runner executes 25 checks
evidence: tests/spine_check.cpp:180: std::printf("spine-check: ALL GREEN (34 checks)\n"); — hardcoded, not derived from Failures/total. Actual count from the file: 15 CHECK statement lines (grep -c 'CHECK(' = 16 including the #define), of which 2 are in loops (8 + 4 iterations) plus 13 static = 25 executions. README.md:19: 'tests/build/spine-check reproduces the Odin pinned vectors byte-exact (34 checks green, no engine needed)'; docs/research-report.md:23 and docs/project-context.md:85 repeat '34 checks'.
detail: The runner, README, research report, and project-context all claim 34; the real count is 25. Factual-accuracy drift in the determinism-spine evidence surface.
recommended_fix: Print the executed-check count dynamically (increment a total counter alongside Failures) or correct the number to 25 in spine_check.cpp, README.md, and docs/.

title: AGENTS.md spine-check rebuild one-liner fails on a fresh clone (missing mkdir -p tests/build)
evidence: AGENTS.md:21: `g++ -std=c++17 -O2 -I Source/PacketPlumberCore tests/spine_check.cpp -o tests/build/spine-check`. .gitignore contains '/tests/build/', so a fresh clone has no tests/build. Verified in a git-archive clone at /tmp/pp-clone: 'ld: open() failed, errno=2 for tests/build/spine-check'. local-ci.sh gate 2 avoids this via 'mkdir -p tests/build && g++ ...'.
detail: The documented rebuild command — the contract for every future spine change — fails as written on any fresh clone; only local-ci's variant works.
recommended_fix: Prepend 'mkdir -p tests/build && ' to the AGENTS.md rebuild command (and to the README quickstart mention of tests/build/spine-check).
